headline: OpenAI announces three big science discoveries and a new way to work with academics
summary: OpenAI reveals three new major discoveries in math, computer science, and physics. External experts, called "shepherds," are now guiding research results. This follows a previous release of numerous math solutions.

headline: Samsung’s Switch 2-ready MicroSD Express card is on sale for less than $50
summary: Samsung's P9 MicroSD Express card is now discounted below $50. It's ideal for expanding storage on the upcoming Nintendo Switch 2. The 256GB version is $47.99, a significant saving from its usual price.

headline: Anthropic is burning gas to feed the AI boom
summary: Anthropic's S-1 filing highlights generative AI's reliance on methane. Data centers powering AI are increasingly dependent on natural gas. Competition for electrical supply and data center locations is intense.

headline: iPhone Duo now supports Apple Pencil with iOS 27.2
summary: The latest iOS 27.2 update adds Apple Pencil support to the iPhone Duo. A new "Edge Light" feature enhances video calls on the device. Apple fulfills its promise for Pencil compatibility on the iPhone Duo.

headline: This TSA-Compliant Daran 89.6Wh 100W LiFePO4 Power Station Drops to Just $49.99
summary: The Daran 89.6Wh 100W LiFePO4 Power Station is now only $49.99. It's TSA-compliant and weighs under 3 pounds, perfect for travel. This is a great deal on a compact, powerful charging device.

headline: Amazon's Lord of the Rings Gandalf Costume Has Dropped to Its Lowest Price of the Year
summary: The Lord of the Rings Gandalf costume on Amazon has reached its lowest price ever. This iconic outfit is now available at a significant discount. Perfect for fans or upcoming costume events.

headline: T-Mobile Is Offering $1,000 Off the Latest Apple iPhone 18 Pro and Pro Max
summary: T-Mobile is offering a massive $1,000 discount on the new iPhone 18 Pro and Pro Max. Customers can get the latest iPhone 18 for under $200. This is a major promotion for Apple's newest flagship phones.

headline: Dead by Daylight Devs Explain Chucky's Exit From Stores and Says Horror Icons Removed Due to Licenses Have 'Open Invitation' to Rejoin
summary: Chucky is being removed from Dead by Daylight stores due to licensing issues. Developers clarify that horror icons removed due to licenses have an "open invitation" to return. Behaviour Interactive addresses character removal concerns from fans.

headline: Kane ends England’s 25-year wait to win men’s Ballon d’Or award
summary: Harry Kane wins the men's Ballon d'Or, ending England's 25-year drought. He is the first English player to win the award since Michael Owen in 2001. Alexia Putellas secures a record-equalling third Ballon d'Or Feminin.

headline: Chris Mason: Budget is imminent as tricky issues pile up for Burnham
summary: A new budget is imminent, bringing complex challenges for Burnham. Key issues include Brexit debates and North Sea oil policy. These topics are generating significant discussion across politics and the country.

headline: Chancellor to cut tariffs on some staple goods to offer cost of living help
summary: The Chancellor plans to cut tariffs on essential staple goods. This move aims to provide much-needed "breathing space" for households. It's part of a broader strategy to alleviate the cost of living crisis.

headline: Israel and the US are both going to the polls - the consequences will be global
summary: Israel and the US are both holding elections within the next two weeks. The outcomes are expected to profoundly impact global geopolitics. These elections will also play a crucial role in shaping the global economy.
